//: What scripts/check/check-traceability.py needs to know about the item's
product functions, beyond the requirements that name them as units
complete: subsystems whose low-level requirements are all written. In
one of these, a product function no requirement names, that is no
accessor and is not listed below, fails the gate: the 'no unintended
function' report is a ratchet there. A subsystem enters when its part
of the report is empty, in the slice that empties it.
check_code_in_product: functions that are checks, or serve only checks,
and live in a product file, so that no `Verifies:` tag may go on them
and the item's size counts them. Each is to move into a check file; an
entry says why it is check code and what keeps it where it is. The
target is an empty map, and the gate fails on an entry that names no
function or one a requirement names.

check_code_in_product.object::as_if_draining_elsewhere: Runs a check's closure as though another context were draining disposed objects (object/check.rs, block_ring/check.rs). It sets the DISPOSING flag dispose reads, which is private to object/mod.rs.
check_code_in_product.object::pin::check_pin: check_quarantine's pin of one fresh page under a cap of one page.
check_code_in_product.object::pin::check_quarantine: The quarantine's boot check, called from main.rs. It reads pin.rs's private quarantined_pages, release and Pin::with_cap; moved into a check file it verifies the three quarantine requirements (L.object.47 to L.object.49).
check_code_in_product.object::pin::translated_pci_domain: check_quarantine's search for a translated PCI domain.
check_code_in_product.object::process::Exit::for_check: An end no process has, for check_quarantine; it needs Exit's private constructor.
